summary_1line: Bhishma teaches strategy through fables: foresight beats procrastination, and a mouse survives by temporarily allying with its trapped enemy, a cat.

image_candidates.scene_text: A mouse crouches beneath the belly of a cat trapped in a hunter’s net while a mongoose on the ground and an owl on a branch watch hungrily.
As a grim hunter with dogs approaches at dawn, the mouse cuts the final strand of the net and the freed cat leaps up into the banyan tree.
Three fish in a shrinking lake react differently as fishermen drain the water—one fleeing the current, one scheming among captured fish, one doomed in the net.
